reader_summary.headline: This is Zack Fuss and today we’re breaking down European-based payment business, Adyen.
reader_summary.overview: This is Zack Fuss and today we’re breaking down European-based payment business, Adyen. Adyen was founded in Amsterdam in 2006 by a group of payments entrepreneurs who had already built and sold a business in this space. Adyen was their chance to start afresh and build a modern solution to displace the patchwork legacy system that merchants were being forced to use.

key_points.text: To break down the business, I’m joined by Michael Willar, a portfolio manager at Stenham Asset Management.
Our discussion covers Adyen’s single platform solution in detail, the driving force behind their track record of profitable growth.
Please enjoy this breakdown of Adyen.
